# The documented command line of the table-diffing program, release 0.6.0,
# written from its README and `--help` page (the program is not installed
# where these tests run).
  -k, --key-columns TEXT         columns that identify a row
  -t, --update-column TEXT       column that says when a row was last updated
  -c, --columns TEXT             columns compared besides the key
  -l, --limit INT                stop after this many differences
  --bisection-factor INT         segments a range is cut into at each step
  --bisection-threshold INT      rows under which a range is compared whole
  -m, --materialize-to-table TEXT  write the differing rows to a table
  --min-age TEXT                 only rows older than this
  --max-age TEXT                 only rows newer than this
  -s, --stats                    print totals of the comparison
  -d, --debug                    debug logging
  --json                         one JSON object per difference
  -v, --verbose                  verbose logging
  --version                      print the release
  -i, --interactive              ask before each query
  --case-sensitive               treat column names as case sensitive
  --assume-unique-key            skip the check that the key is unique
  --skip-sort-results            leave the differences unsorted
  --sample-exclusive-rows        write a sample of rows found on one side only
  --materialize-all-rows         write every row, not only the differing ones
  --table-write-limit INT        most rows written to the materialized table
  --allow-empty-tables           compare when one side has no rows
  -j, --threads TEXT             connections used to read
  -w, --where TEXT               condition limiting the rows on both sides
  -a, --algorithm TEXT           hashdiff or joindiff
  --conf PATH                    configuration file
  --run TEXT                     run named in the configuration file
feature: databases.connect :: open a connection from an address in code
